name: Making images from text descriptions
gist: Papers on turning written descriptions into images, including ways to control specific attributes, edit existing images, and personalize outputs without retraining the model.
explain: The question here is practical and immediate: given text like 'a red car driving on a sunny beach,' can a system generate an image that matches? This requires the model to do several hard things at once. It has to understand language well enough to parse the description. It has to know what a 'red car' looks like, how cars interact with beaches, what 'sunny' looks like in terms of lighting and color. And it has to follow the instruction while still generating something that looks realistic and detailed—not a flat, obvious match but something that feels like a genuine photograph or painting.

The difficulty is that text and images don't line up neatly. The word 'red' doesn't have one visual representation—it could mean bright red, dark red, saturated red, muted red. The model has to figure out from context. Also, people ask for increasingly specific things: 'make the car red but not the wheels,' 'keep the person's face the same but change their expression.' The model has to understand boundaries between objects and concepts. And then there's the personalization angle—can you fine-tune a model to generate images of a specific person or object without retraining from scratch?

Research here falls into several clusters. Some papers improve how language is connected to images—better ways to represent text instructions so the model understands them more precisely by mapping words to visual concepts more accurately. Others focus on attribute control: given a generated image, can you change specific properties (color, size, pose) without regenerating everything, because users want to iterate (e.g., 'keep the dog, but make it blue')? Still others tackle editing existing images: given a photo and a text instruction ('remove the tree'), can the model erase and re-imagine that region, which is useful for cleanup or creative changes? And an important cluster works on personalization—letting users show the model a few examples of what they care about (their face, their art style) and having it generate new variations without expensive retraining, which is practical because full retraining takes days. These approaches include techniques like fine-tuning on small examples (training the model slightly on just the user's data), which works because even a tiny amount of training on user-specific examples shapes the model to match their preferences, storing a signature of the user's content and conditioning generation on it (so the model remembers who to draw), or learning lightweight adaptations (small adjustment modules that plug into the model).

papers.title: CO3: CONTRASTING CONCEPTS COMPOSE BETTER
papers.contribution: Improves concept coverage, balance and robustness with fewer dropped or distorted concepts compared to baselines, using plug-and-play approach without model tuning.

papers.title: Cross-ControlNet: Training-Free Fusion of Multiple Conditions for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.contribution: Training-free framework achieves consistent improvements in controllable generation under both conflicting and complementary conditions and generalizes to DiT-based FLUX models without additional training.

papers.title: Exploring the Design Space of Transition Matching
papers.contribution: Identifies MLP head with specific time weighting and high-frequency sampling as best overall, achieving state-of-the-art among tested baselines with detailed efficiency-quality tradeoffs.

papers.title: From Broad Exploration to Stable Synthesis: Entropy-Guided Optimization for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard T2I benchmarks by excluding low-entropy tokens from reward updates and adding entropy bonuses to high-entropy tokens.

papers.title: MILR: Improving Multimodal Image Generation via Test-Time Latent Reasoning
papers.contribution: MILR achieves state-of-the-art results on GenEval, T2I-CompBench, and WISE benchmarks with 80% improvement on knowledge-intensive WISE tasks, demonstrating strong temporal and cultural reasoning capabilities.

papers.title: Mitigating Semantic Collapse in Generative Personalization with Test-Time Embedding Adjustment
papers.contribution: Demonstrates significant improvements in text-image alignment across different personalization methods and diverse use cases.

papers.title: NextStep-1: Toward Autoregressive Image Generation with Continuous Tokens at Scale
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art autoregressive text-to-image generation with strong high-fidelity synthesis and image editing capabilities.

papers.title: Object Fidelity Diffusion for Remote Sensing Image Generation
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art across quality metrics with mAP increases of 8.3% for airplanes, 7.7% for ships, and 4.0% for vehicles.

papers.title: RePrompt: Reasoning-Augmented Reprompting for Text-to-Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Significantly boosts spatial layout fidelity and compositional generalization across diverse T2I backbones, establishing state-of-the-art results on GenEval and T2I-Compbench.

papers.title: VINCIE: Unlocking In-context Image Editing from Video
papers.contribution: Despite training only on videos, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on multi-turn image editing benchmarks and demonstrates capabilities in multi-concept composition and story generation.

papers.title: VSF: Simple, Efficient, and Effective Negative Guidance in Few-Step Image Generation Models By Value Sign Flip
papers.contribution: Achieves 0.420-0.545 negative score on NegGenBench, significantly improving over prior few-step methods (0.320-0.380) and CFG (0.300), with minimal computational overhead.

papers.title: ACCORD: Alleviating Concept Coupling through Dependence Regularization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Personalization
papers.contribution: ACCORD achieves superior balance between personalization fidelity and text control across subject, style, and face personalization benchmarks.

papers.title: Active Tabular Augmentation via Policy-Guided Diffusion Inpainting
papers.contribution: Under severe data scarcity, TAP improves classification accuracy by up to 15.6 percentage points and reduces regression RMSE by up to 32% compared to strong generative baselines.

papers.title: CacheEdit: Efficient Multi-round Image Editing via Adaptive Token-wise Reuse.
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2.5× end-to-end acceleration while improving instruction-following and structural consistency.

papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art counterfactual editing on synthetic and real datasets outperforming baselines in effectiveness, composition, realism, and identity preservation.

papers.title: ChronoEdit: Towards Temporal Reasoning for In-Context Image Editing and World Simulation
papers.contribution: ChronoEdit surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in both visual fidelity and physical plausibility on the new PBench-Edit benchmark.

papers.contribution: Achieves 0.86 on GenEval and 7.468 on Imagine-Bench, reaching competitive text-to-image generation performance with video models.

papers.contribution: This paper reveals that a key source of ID shift is the native correlation between subject and scene context, called scene contextualization, which arises naturally as T2I models fit the training distribution of vast natural images.

papers.title: ContrastiveCFG: Guiding Diffusion Sampling by Contrasting Positive and Negative Concepts
papers.contribution: Effectively injects or removes given concepts while maintaining sample quality across diverse scenarios from simple class conditions to complex overlapping text prompts.

papers.title: CountsDiff: A diffusion model on the natural numbers for generation and imputation of count-based data
papers.contribution: Matches or surpasses state-of-the-art discrete generative models and scRNA-seq imputation methods on single-cell RNA data while leaving substantial headroom for optimization.

papers.title: DeLeaker: Dynamic Inference-Time Reweighting For Semantic Leakage Mitigation in Text-to-Image Models
papers.contribution: DeLeaker outperforms baselines without compromising fidelity or quality, with a new SLIM dataset of 1,130 human-verified leakage examples.

papers.title: DirectEdit: Step-Level Accurate Inversion for Flow-Based Image Editing
papers.contribution: Achieves efficient and accurate image editing with superior performance over state-of-the-art methods without introducing additional neural function evaluations.

papers.title: Directional Textual Inversion for Personalized Text-to-Image Generation

papers.title: DistillKac: Few-Step Image Generation via Damped Wave Equations
papers.contribution: DistillKac delivers high-quality samples with very few function evaluations while retaining numerical stability benefits of finite-speed probability flows.

papers.title: Diverse Text-to-Image Generation via Contrastive Noise Optimization
papers.contribution: The approach achieves superior quality-diversity Pareto frontier across multiple T2I backbones while remaining robust to hyperparameter choices.

papers.title: Dragging with Geometry: From Pixels to Geometry-Guided Image Editing
papers.contribution: Achieves coherent, high-fidelity, structure-consistent editing in single forward pass with superior precision and multi-point editability.

papers.title: End-to-End Autoregressive Image Generation with 1D Semantic Tokenizer

papers.title: Envisioning Beyond the Few: Disentangled Semantics and Primitives for Few-Shot Atypical Layout-to-Image Generation
papers.contribution: Shows consistent improvements in 5-shot regime over state-of-the-art L2I methods in visual fidelity and alignment across diverse atypical domains.

papers.title: Factored Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.contribution: Significantly improves axiomatic soundness of counterfactuals across natural and medical images by mitigating spurious amplification.

papers.title: Factuality Matters: When Image Generation and Editing Meet Structured Visuals
papers.contribution: The approach achieves state-of-the-art open-source performance on structured image generation and editing with consistent gains from inference-time reasoning; StructScore metric introduced for fine-grained factual evaluation.

papers.title: FlowAlign: Trajectory-Regularized, Inversion-Free Flow-based Image Editing
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing methods in source preservation and editing controllability; naturally supports reversible editing via trajectory reversal.

papers.title: GASS: Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling for Disentangled Diversity Enhancement in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.contribution: GASS increases geometric projection spread for both axes, improving diversity while maintaining fidelity and semantic alignment across multiple frozen T2I backbones.

papers.title: Gradient Preconditioning for Efficient and Reliable Reward-Guided Generation
papers.contribution: On FLUX with four reward models, the approach reaches comparable Aesthetic Score using only 30% of the wall-clock time required by state-of-the-art regularization methods, with negligible FFT-matching overhead.

papers.title: Guidance Matters: Rethinking the Evaluation Pitfall for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.contribution: Reveals that simply increasing CFG scales can compete with most studied diffusion guidance methods, and empirically evaluates eight methods showing most suffer from the guidance bias pitfall.

papers.title: I-DRUID: Layout to image generation via instance-disentangled representation and unpaired data
papers.contribution: Demonstrates improved layout-to-image generation accuracy by combining instance disentanglement with RL on unpaired, prompt-only data to avoid the need for paired data collection.

papers.title: Improving Classifier-Free Guidance of Flow Matching via Manifold Projection
papers.contribution: Training-free methods refine generation fidelity, prompt alignment, and robustness across DiT-XL-2-256, Flux, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 with significant improvements.

papers.title: Latent Forcing: Reordering the Diffusion Trajectory for Pixel-Space Image Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves new state-of-the-art for diffusion transformer-based pixel generation at its compute scale while maintaining latent efficiency.

papers.title: Latent Wavelet Diffusion For Ultra High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.contribution: Improves perceptual quality and FID across baselines with zero inference cost and no architectural changes, enabling efficient high-resolution synthesis.

papers.title: Locality-aware Parallel Decoding for Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.contribution: Reduces generation steps from 256 to 20 for 256x256 resolution and 1024 to 48 for 512x512 resolution with 3.4x lower latency while maintaining quality.

papers.title: Long-Text-to-Image Generation via Compositional Prompt Decomposition
papers.contribution: Achieves performance comparable to specialized tuning while demonstrating superior generalization, outperforming other models by 7.4% on prompts over 500 tokens in the DetailMaster benchmark.

papers.title: MAMBO-G: Magnitude-Aware Mitigation for Boosted Guidance
papers.contribution: MAMBO-G achieves up to 3× speedup on Stable Diffusion v3.5, 4× on Lumina, and 2× on the 14B Wan2.1 video model while preserving visual fidelity.

papers.title: MICE-Bench: A Challenging and Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Creation and Editing
papers.contribution: Shows all models experience degradation in concept consistency under complexity; closed-source models maintain advantage, indicating substantial improvement room.

papers.title: MIRO: MultI-Reward cOnditioned pretraining improves T2I quality and efficiency
papers.contribution: Improves visual quality and speeds up training on GenEval compositional benchmark and user-preference scores (PickAScore, ImageReward, HPSv2), achieving state-of-the-art performance.

papers.title: MIST: Moment-Aligned Invariant Stability Transform for Robust Flow Matching
papers.contribution: MIST enables robust high-fidelity generation across wide guidance scales while outperforming standard CFG on text-to-image and text-to-video benchmarks.

papers.title: Many-for-Many: Unify the Training of Multiple Video and Image Generation and Manipulation Tasks
papers.contribution: Single models (8B/2B) perform 10+ distinct tasks with competitive performance versus open-source and commercial engines.

papers.title: NeuralOS: Towards Simulating Operating Systems via Neural Generative Models

papers.title: One-step Latent-free Image Generation with Pixel Mean Flows

papers.title: Overshoot and Shrinkage in Classifier-Free Guidance: From Theory to Practice

papers.title: Personalized Image Generation via Human-in-the-loop Bayesian Optimization
papers.contribution: Shows users can effectively guide generative models toward personalized targets through multi-choice feedback; qualitative user scores and quantitative metrics show promising results across five baselines.

papers.title: Preserve and Personalize: Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models without Distributional Drift
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance in visual fidelity and prompt adherence through bounded deviation from original distribution, with computational efficiency over resource-intensive sampling.

papers.title: Product-Quantised Image Representation for High-Quality Image Synthesis
papers.contribution: Achieves PSNR of 37dB (prior work 27dB) and reduces FID, LPIPS, CMMD by up to 96%; integrates seamlessly into pretrained diffusion models for faster generation or doubled resolution.

papers.title: Prompt Reinjection: Alleviating Prompt Forgetting in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Consistent improvements on GenEval, DPG, and T2I-CompBench++ in instruction-following capability and text-image generation quality across SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1.

papers.title: PromptRL: Prompt Matters in RL for Flow-Based Image Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves 0.97 GenEval, 0.98 OCR accuracy, 24.05 PickScore; improves FLUX.1-Kontext from 1.19 to 1.43 EditReward with 50% fewer rollouts than naive flow-only RL.

papers.title: Purrception: Variational Flow Matching for Vector-Quantized Image Generation
papers.contribution: Purrception trains faster than both continuous and discrete flow matching baselines while achieving competitive FID scores on ImageNet-1k 256×256.

papers.title: Responsible Text-to-Image Diffusion: Interpretable and Linearly Controllable Semantics for Fair and Safe Generation
papers.contribution: Provide interpretability, linearity, and significantly improved fairness while preserving visual fidelity across SDXL, SD3.5, PixArt, and FLUX models.

papers.title: Restoring Initial Noise Sensitivity in Text-to-Image Distillation through Geometric Alignment
papers.contribution: GAD significantly restores sensitivity to initial noise and improves diversity while maintaining visual fidelity across multiple T2I paradigms and noise-driven control tasks.

papers.title: SIGMA-GEN: STRUCTURE AND IDENTITY GUIDED MULTI-SUBJECT ASSEMBLY FOR IMAGE GENERATION

papers.title: SenseFlow: Scaling Distribution Matching for Flow-based Text-to-Image Distillation

papers.title: Spectral Evolution Search: Efficient Inference-Time Scaling for Reward-Aligned Image Generation
papers.contribution: Substantially improves the trade-off between generation quality and computational cost compared to baselines under the same compute budget.

papers.title: TIPO: Text to Image with Text Pre-sampling for Prompt Optimization
papers.contribution: TIPO provides efficient prompt optimization with substantial improvements in aesthetic quality and artifact reduction compared to resource-intensive LLM or RL methods.
